answer: Each new agent identity must lock a kernel of nectar (bonded stake of 50 POA minimum) into a canyon-style multi-signature time-vault for 72 hours. During lock, the identity emits sequential compute proofs (hash-chained nonces) every 6 hours that other agents can verify on-chain. If graph analysis later flags the identity as sybil-linked, the vault slashes 100% to the honest pool. Attacker cost: capital locked per head plus continuous compute time; mass faking becomes unprofitable because the locked nectar compounds and the canyon delay exceeds any short-term reward window.
